SessionStart.purpose: copy plugin/docs into ~/.claude-code-docs only when the installed plugin version differs from the version recorded in the .magic-claude-docs-plugin marker (or the marker/manifest is missing) — a no-op on every other session start
print at most one line when the installed plugin version or the digested Claude Code version has drifted from what is now current

outputs: SessionStart hook stdout is appended to the session's context (undocumented but relied upon here — the version-signal line is meant to be read by the model, not the user's terminal)

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/*.md
files.where: SessionStart hook 0 — sync target, read by the docs skill

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/NNNN-wNN.md
files.where: plugin/skills/docs/SKILL.md — weekly digest pages: primary source for "what's new", direct target for "week NN", listed under their own heading in the no-argument listing

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/.magic-claude-docs-plugin
files.where: SessionStart hook 0 (plugin/hooks/sync-docs.sh) — marker file, now holds the synced plugin VERSION (not just a touch marker), written only after a successful copy

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/.published-version
files.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh — cache read in the foreground, written by the detached refresh

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/.published-version.fetched_at
files.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh — cache-age stamp, gates the 3h refresh interval

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/latest
files.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh — read only; written by a later card

files.name: $HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/*
files.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh — fallback source for the running Claude Code version when `claude --version` is unavailable

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/<version>.gather.json
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/gather.mjs — raw gather output, one per Claude Code version

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/<version>.json
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/analyze.mjs — { result, sources, gatheredAt, analyzedAt, deliveredAt }; deliveredAt/deliveryNote set later by plugin/digest/bin/mark-delivered.mjs

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/<version>.md
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/analyze.mjs — rendered digest, posted verbatim to Atrium by plugin/skills/digest/SKILL.md step 4

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/<version>.snapshot.json
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/analyze.mjs — docs-changed snapshot carried forward to the next gather

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/<version>.lock
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/analyze.mjs — concurrency guard, stale after 30 minutes

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digests/latest
files.where: plugin/digest/bin/analyze.mjs — written last, atomically; read by plugin/skills/digest/SKILL.md's status/show sub-commands

files.name: $HOME/.claude-code-docs/digest-targets.json
files.where: plugin/digest/src/gather.mjs (manifestPath entries) and plugin/skills/digest/SKILL.md step 4 (boardId/listId/atriumMention entries) — see plugin/digest/digest-targets.example.json

cli.name: claude --version
cli.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh get_claude_code_version — run with </dev/null and a 5s timeout

cli.name: curl -fsS --max-time 5
cli.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh do_refresh_published — detached background fetch of upstream plugin.json, never in the foreground path

cli.name: jq -r .version
cli.where: plugin/hooks/version-signal.sh extract_json_version — used when present; falls back to grep/sed otherwise

invariants: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs exists at SessionStart, or the copy hook is a no-op
sync-docs.sh skips the copy when the marker already equals the installed version AND docs_manifest.json exists in the target; otherwise it re-copies and writes the marker LAST
rm -rf "$D"/* does not remove dotfiles, so the marker and version-signal.sh's .published-version caches survive every re-copy
SessionStart hook stdout reaches the model as context
the copy hook (SessionStart[0]) and the version-signal hook (SessionStart[1]) are two separate command entries, never merged into one
version-signal.sh prints at most one line and never exits non-zero, on any input combination
version-signal.sh never makes a blocking network call in the foreground; the published-version cache is refreshed for the NEXT run only, detached
the published-version cache is treated as fresh for 3 hours, matching the upstream CI's own fetch cadence
